parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The WAF ruleset ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListWafRulesets](~~2878359~~) API.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The ID of the site. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) API.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site configuration. For a site with configuration version management enabled, this parameter specifies the version to update. The default value is 0.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The target status of the ruleset.
